title: GRAVEBLOOM — Master Canonical Game Design & Build Specification

project.title: GRAVEBLOOM
project.subtitle: A Requiem in Ash and Crimson
project.engine: Custom TypeScript Canvas 2D Engine with Web Audio Synthesizer

resolution.scaling: Pixel-crisp responsive canvas letterboxing with touch coordinate transform

creativePillars.name: Somber & Weighty Dark Fantasy Atmosphere
creativePillars.description: A world of fading ash, creeping crimson corruption, petrified colossi, and bone-white remnants. Every swing, parry, and death feels intentional and heavy.

creativePillars.name: Deliberate Stamina & I-Frame Combat
creativePillars.description: Combat rewards observation and timing. Light/Heavy attacks, directional rolls with 0.25s i-frames, tight parry windows, and weapon-specific Ember Arts.

creativePillars.name: Crimson Flask & Ash Reclamation Loop
creativePillars.description: Flask charges heal 40% max HP, refilling at Bloomstones. On death, lost Ash drops as a glowing Ashlight wisp at the death site to be reclaimed on the next run.

creativePillars.name: Seamless PC & Mobile Parity
creativePillars.description: Full keyboard & mouse support with custom UI pointer clicks, direct gamepad polling, and an adaptive multi-touch virtual analog stick + action button HUD.

creativePillars.name: Attunement & Cindersmithing Progression
creativePillars.description: Level up 6 core attributes at Bloomstones or the Waking Choir. Forge and upgrade weapons up to +10 using raw ashen ore, cindersteel, and marshstone.

origins.name: The Wanderer
origins.description: A cloaked exile from the withered steppes. Balanced in combat with high adaptability.
origins.playstyle: Balanced swordplay and versatile roll timing

origins.name: Knight-Errant
origins.description: An armored crusader of a fallen order. High physical defense, heavy poise, and brutal poise damage.
origins.playstyle: High poise, sweeping strikes, heavy defense

origins.name: Ashborn Cleric
origins.description: A zealot who speaks the sacred ash-chants. High healing affinity and sustained resolve.
origins.playstyle: Healing incantations, poise breaks, blunt impact

origins.name: The Duelist
origins.description: A swift fencer clad in worn leather. Excels at rapid thrusts, bleed buildup, and pinpoint parries.
origins.playstyle: Agile rolls, fast strikes, high critical parry ripostes

origins.name: Hexweaver
origins.description: A renegade occultist who binds eldritch embers to consume foes from afar.

origins.name: Grave-Digger
origins.description: A hardened laborer unearthing the sepulchers of forgotten gods. High poise and heavy cleaves.
origins.playstyle: Armor piercing, staggered foes, sustained stamina

origins.name: Beastcaller
origins.description: A feral tracker who channels the spirits of the marsh beasts to enhance speed and strike potency.

origins.name: The Hollow
origins.description: A stripped, nameless vessel possessing nothing but raw potential.
origins.playstyle: Ultimate customization and challenging early game

regions.name: Ashen Vigil (Hub)
regions.lore: A sanctuary built around the Grand Bloomstone where survivors gather to kindle hope against the Hush.

regions.name: The Ashen Coast
regions.lore: A grey shore where black sand meets petrified tidepools. The starting gate of the pilgrimage.

regions.name: Cindermoor
regions.lore: Rolling hills of smoldering turf and charred watchtowers. Patrolled by Ashen Sentinels.

regions.name: The Gravebloom Marsh
regions.lore: A suffocating swamp where bloated roots feed on decaying embers. Poisonous spores linger.

regions.name: The Ember Waste
regions.lore: A scorched expanse of cracked basalt and geysers of white-hot slag.

regions.name: The Silent Cathedral
regions.lore: A towering gothic temple of obsidian stone where the silence itself crushes resolve.
regions.boss: Vaelith, Voice of the Hollow Bough

regions.name: Rootdeep
regions.lore: The labyrinthine undergrowth beneath the world's surface. Chittering terrors crawl within.

regions.name: Frostspire Reach
regions.lore: Freezing pinnacles where ash is frozen into razor-sharp icicles.

regions.name: The Hollow Bough
regions.lore: The colossal petrified canopy overlooking the abyss.

regions.name: The Hollow Throne & The Mirror Void
regions.lore: The heart of the silence where the Father of Ash awaits, and the mirror reflects the Unspoken Twin.
regions.boss: The Hollow King / The Unspoken Twin

majorBosses.name: Ser Ashgrave
majorBosses.phase1: Measured halberd thrusts, shield bashes, and heavy sweeps.
majorBosses.phase2: Crimson burst: ignited polearm, sweeping shockwaves, and leap slams.

majorBosses.name: Sir Corvain
majorBosses.phase1: Noble greatsword stance, graceful parries, and thrust lunges.
majorBosses.phase2: Dual-wielding broken cindersword, relentless whirlwind combos.

majorBosses.name: The Bloomwarden
majorBosses.phase1: Root whips, poison spore blooms, and ground spikes.
majorBosses.phase2: Enraged blooming vines, arena-wide spore fog, and burrow strikes.

majorBosses.name: The Cinder Choir
majorBosses.phase1: Three chanting sisters linked by a molten ribbon with synchronized fire bolts.
majorBosses.phase2: Ascended choir: rotating flame pillars and area-wide ember storms.

majorBosses.name: The Root Mother
majorBosses.phase1: Multi-limb subterranean sweeps, creeping larvae summons.
majorBosses.phase2: Frenzied thrashing with overhead venom showers.

majorBosses.name: Vaelith
majorBosses.phase1: Acoustic hexes, sound shockwaves, and silent teleports.
majorBosses.phase2: Resonant shattering shriek, homing sonic needles.

majorBosses.name: The Frost Widow
majorBosses.phase1: Razor silk tethers, icicle rain, and ceiling drops.
majorBosses.phase2: Frost armor, web frenzy, and freezing blizzard breath.

majorBosses.name: The Hollow King
majorBosses.phase1: Colossal greatsword strikes, molten stomp shockwaves, and ember cleaves.
majorBosses.phase2: Unleashed Ash Storm, dual-handed cataclysm, and crimson corona.

majorBosses.name: The Unspoken Twin
majorBosses.phase1: Mirrors the player's exact equipment, movement, and timing.
majorBosses.phase2: Spectral afterimages, counter-parry ripostes, and void ember bursts.

mobileTouch.virtualJoystick: Dynamic Left-Side Analog Touch with 45px deadzone and directional smoothing
